state_vocabulary.BLOCKED: obligation cannot be satisfied until an external condition changes; owner and condition recorded
state_vocabulary.DEFERRED_WITH_OWNER: binding=deferred; owner, future stage, observable disposition and evidence obligation recorded
state_vocabulary.PASS: reserved; zero PASS claims are permitted in P0
state_vocabulary.PLANNED: obligation accepted at P0; binding is static, attestation or doc_check; no implementation claim
